label: Tablet

questions.why: Poor or mismatched chargers are a common cause of battery and port damage.

questions.text: Does the tablet have a case and a screen guard?
questions.why: They take the knocks that crack screens.

questions.text: Is it mostly used by children?
questions.why: Drops and spills are more common with young users.

questions.text: Is it often charged or left in hot places?
Has it been dropped hard in the last few months?
questions.why: Drops can damage inner parts even without visible cracks.

questions.text: Have you noticed the battery swelling, the tablet getting very hot or draining fast?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Stop using the tablet and keep it away from anything that can burn if the battery swells, gets very hot or smells unusual.
care_tips.why: A damaged battery can catch fire.

care_tips.text: Don't open, puncture or crush the battery, and don't use it after a hard fall that dented it.
care_tips.why: Damaged battery cells can overheat or catch fire.

care_tips.text: Switch the tablet off and unplug the charger before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning a charging device risks a short circuit.

care_tips.text: Charge with the charger it came with or another certified one.
care_tips.why: Poor chargers can damage the battery.

care_tips.text: Use a sturdy case and a screen guard.
Avoid charging or leaving the tablet in hot places.
Clean the screen with a soft dry cloth and no sprays.
care_tips.why: Liquids can seep in and damage the screen.
Updates fix bugs and security problems.

care_tips.text: If it runs very hot or drains fast, contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: These can be signs of a battery problem.

reminders.text: Back up the photos and files on your tablet.
reminders.note: Check your manual or device settings for automatic backup.
